vb_textbox.text: Personally, even though the instructions had mentioned that the quickness of your response doesn't impact the timer you're given to make a decisionn that's presented to you, I couldn't help but notice that there was a slight correlation on choosing the gnome on the right more than the left, and clicking Space as quickly as you can seemed to increase the amount of mushrooms you pick in the forest. The slower you are to click to collect, the less mushrooms you acquire.
